limits: Finite declared-rival census, not proof of identifiability.
Unique inputs are exact normalized grid hashes, not semantic equivalence.
Start residues describe requested starts. Accepted pair residues use runner-recorded indices only; missing metadata is not inferred.
Rotations reuse each materialized bundle; they do not enumerate all cyclic windows or new draws.
Declared rivals must be pure and deterministic; predictions are cached by rival name and input hash.
Schedule period is a generator declaration, not independently proven; fixed-seed enumeration does not exhaust random support or rejected-pair schedules.

selection.policy: aggregate counts, all failing lessons, one complete successful lesson per band

sampler.authority: runner.run_one with selected canonical Racket rule
sampler.rotation_recipe: hold out every labelled pair once; preserve remaining order
sampler.seed_recipe: schedule_seed fixed across all starts and bands
sampler.start_recipe: index (consecutive requested starts; accepted indices may advance)

schedule_coverage.scope: Every declared starting residue and query position at this fixed seed and these bands only.

searched_rival_policy: advisory; separate from declared-rival verdict; rotations follow explicit rotation_policy
